extension.description: Browse and play audiobooks and podcasts from your AudioBookShelf server.
extension.news: v0.24.0 Sign-in reworked. Your password is no longer stored: there is a Sign in button that exchanges it for tokens once and forgets it, plus Test connection and Sign out. Existing installs migrate automatically and the stored password is cleared. Now uses AudioBookShelf's current access/refresh token model with automatic renewal, instead of the token the server marks deprecated. Added an HTTPS certificate option and a per-install device ID.
